# VexRiscv Generated RTL Snapshot

This directory contains a generated VexRiscv RTL snapshot used by the ECOS
frontend catalog.

Source:

- Repository: https://github.com/litex-hub/pythondata-cpu-vexriscv
- Revision used for this snapshot: `642ecfed1c84460555d6d803d660cc60cfc1ecb6`
- Upstream generator: https://github.com/SpinalHDL/VexRiscv
- Selected RTL: `pythondata_cpu_vexriscv/verilog/VexRiscv_Min.v`

The ECOS adapter wraps this Wishbone-based generated CPU into the stable
`ysyx-axi-cpu-socket-v1` contract.
